timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,511 KRW/USD (currently elevated)

WHY: The won is WEAK right now, with the exchange rate recently entering the 1,500 KRW/USD range—meaning you're paying more won per dollar than usual. News indicates the rate is expected to improve (return to 1,400s) later this month as geopolitical tensions ease, suggesting better timing is coming soon.

TIP: If possible, wait a few days or weeks for the won to strengthen toward 1,400 levels before converting your monthly $2,000, as this would reduce your KRW cost significantly.
